notes.title: Release Postponed
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
We're sad to announce that we needed to further postpone the launch of SpaceEscapeVR due to the current worldwide situation.
As we are not full time developers we need to make sure we can get through these harsh times.
Development has not stopped, just slowed down.

We hope you are and stay healthy and safe!
Your VRA-Games team!

notes.title: Bugfixes!
notes.notes:
As you might have noticed, there has been a long time between the initial release and the last Update. 
But you may also have noticed that in the last days SpaceEscapeVR has been patched again!
The game is not dead!
We just had so much work with our Arcade that we barely had any time left. But don't worry, the bughunt is still going on!
If you have found a bug, feel free to report it on our Discord: https://discord.gg/BH5BrtH (the devs speak english :D)
